career_ladder.note: Revenue Patwaris are the foundational grassroots revenue and land records administration officials under the Board of Revenue (राजस्व मंडल), Ajmer, Government of Rajasthan. They maintain village land titles (Jamabandi), conduct crop inspections (Girdawari), certify mutation entries (Namantaran), and assist district administration in disaster relief and land acquisition.

exam_scheme.note: The Rajasthan Patwari Direct Recruitment Examination consists of a single-stage objective competitive written examination of 150 questions carrying 300 marks for a duration of 3 hours, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates. For every incorrect response, 1/3rd of the marks assigned to that question (0.67 marks) is deducted as negative marking.

financial_package.note: Revenue Patwaris are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-5 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,400) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹14,600 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹20,800 is drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule I Level L-5
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-5 entry basic pay of ₹20,800 at 58% DA (₹12,064 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹1,872 to ₹3,744), fixed rural field allowance / patwar baste allowance, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district and posting classification
Patwar baste allowance and field travel reimbursement for revenue survey duties
Cashless medical facility across empanelled hospitals under RGHS
Defined pension coverage under restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
Privilege leave, causal leave, and annual leave travel concession benefits
